payload.purpose_context: Yolan uses an older Intel Mac (macOS Monterey 12.7.6) that cannot run the Claude Code IDE extension, so he needs a distinct, more advanced learning path built around the command line: terminal setup and styling, Git/GitHub, hands-on MCP, spec-driven development, building tools with Claude Code, and a real capstone project -- while dropping the Gemini-specific content that doesn't apply to him. This requires both new module content and a profile-aware module-list mechanism so his profile loads a different curriculum than the shared one.
payload.purpose_tldr: Give Yolan his own CLI-focused module track in the onboarding app, replacing the shared IDE-based curriculum he can't use.
